cues.en: So, we've shown that even a single Ubuntu system with a single GPU can crunch massive datasets when generating recommendations using deep learning in a short amount of time.
cues.zh: 我們已經看到，即使只有一台搭載單一 GPU 的 Ubuntu 系統，也能透過深度學習，在短時間內處理龐大資料集並產生推薦。

cues.en: But what if you need to scale up even more, to the point where a single GPU can't handle it?
cues.zh: 但如果還需要進一步擴展，大到單一 GPU 都無法負荷呢？

cues.en: Well, Amazon has told us how to do that, as well.
cues.zh: Amazon 也告訴我們該怎麼做。

cues.en: On the AWS Blog, you'll find an article called Generating Recommendations at Amazon Scale with Apache Spark and Amazon DSSTNE.
cues.zh: 在 AWS Blog 可以找到一篇文章，叫做 Generating Recommendations at Amazon Scale with Apache Spark and Amazon DSSTNE。

cues.en: Just like it sounds, they are combining the power of DSSTNE with the power of Apache Spark, using the same Amazon Web Services you or I can use.
cues.zh: 顧名思義，他們把 DSSTNE 和 Apache Spark 的能力結合起來，用的正是你我都能使用的 Amazon Web Services。

cues.en: The basic idea is to use Spark to distribute the job of data analytics and processing, such as the conversion of data into NetCDF format that we just did, on the CPU from Spark Executor nodes.
cues.zh: 基本想法是透過 Spark，把資料分析與處理工作分散到 Spark Executor 節點的 CPU 上，例如剛才將資料轉成 NetCDF 格式的工作。

cues.en: Once the data is partitioned by Spark, it's handed off to another cluster dedicated to GPU computing, where DSSTNE can train its neural networks on that data.
cues.zh: Spark 把資料分割好之後，就交給另一個專門進行 GPU 運算的叢集，讓 DSSTNE 在那些資料上訓練神經網路。

cues.en: To take a step back, Spark can't manage clusters of GPUs, so they use two different clusters, a Spark cluster to wrangle their data and partition it up,
cues.zh: 退一步來說，Spark 無法管理 GPU 叢集，所以他們使用兩個不同的叢集：一個 Spark 叢集負責整理與分割資料，

cues.en: and then another GPU cluster that's actually managed by Amazon's container management service, ECS.
cues.zh: 另一個 GPU 叢集，則由 Amazon 的容器管理服務 ECS 管理。

cues.en: They use Amazon S3 to transfer data between these two clusters.
cues.zh: 兩個叢集之間透過 Amazon S3 傳輸資料。

cues.en: So Spark is our CPU cluster, and ECS is our GPU cluster.
cues.zh: 因此，Spark 是 CPU 叢集，ECS 則是 GPU 叢集。

cues.en: Spark orchestrates the whole thing, using S3 to transfer data back and forth.
cues.zh: Spark 負責協調整個流程，並使用 S3 來回傳輸資料。

cues.en: On a specific GPU slave, Amazon DSSTNE is just one of several technologies that might run to actually process the data.
cues.zh: 在某個 GPU 工作節點上，Amazon DSSTNE 只是可能用來實際處理資料的幾種技術之一。

cues.en: What's even nicer is that Amazon Web Services has auto-scaling features that will automatically allocate and de-allocate these nodes as they are needed.
cues.zh: 更方便的是，Amazon Web Services 有自動擴展功能，能依需要自動配置與釋放這些節點。

cues.en: Amazon published all the details you could possibly want to know about how they scaled up DSSTNE to run on a cluster.
cues.zh: Amazon 已公布所有細節，說明如何擴展 DSSTNE，讓它在叢集上執行。

cues.en: Here's a short link to that article.
cues.zh: 這裡是那篇文章的短網址。

cues.en: You obviously can't run it yourself without first setting up a very large, complex, and expensive cluster to work with, but they even show you Python notebooks where they use this cluster
cues.zh: 當然，你得先建好一個龐大、複雜又昂貴的叢集，才能自行執行。不過，他們甚至提供了 Python notebook，展示如何使用這個叢集，

cues.en: to generate movie recommendations.
cues.zh: 產生電影推薦。

cues.en: They can run the whole thing from a notebook in their browsers.
cues.zh: 整個流程都能從瀏覽器中的 notebook 執行。

cues.en: I think this is a very exciting moment in this course, we've seen how to apply real deep learning networks to massive recommender system problems, and scale it up pretty much infinitely.
cues.zh: 我覺得這是本課程很令人興奮的時刻：我們看到了如何把真正的深度學習網路應用在大規模推薦系統問題，並且幾乎無限地擴展規模。
